basic_details.short_information: IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF) has published the Project Officer Notification 2026 on its official website. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Project Officer position. Candidates with a minimum of 5 years of service in the Armed Forces or equivalent of Pay Band 12 and above in an administrative/managerial role in Civil Organisations are eligible to apply. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Armed Forces Category 'A' training institutes, while an MBA/PGDBM or a diploma/certificate in financial management is desirable. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-07-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Officer post at DRIF?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Officer position at IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF) is 30th July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Officer role?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Officer post in the IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in the Armed Forces or an equivalent administrative/managerial role in civil organizations. An MBA or equivalent is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Officer position is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves CV shortlisting, followed by an online interaction and an in-person interaction.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the Project Officer job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their application via email to the designated email address as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity for the Project Officer position at IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF).

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF) located?
faq.answer: IIT Ropar Defence Research and Innovation Foundation (DRIF) is located in Rupnagar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for more information?
faq.answer: The official website for more information regarding this recruitment and other updates from IIT Ropar is https://www.iitrpr.ac.in.
